# Allstate announces quarterly dividend payable Jan. 4, 2027


November 12, 2026


[Post](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=)


[Post](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=)


[Share](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=)


NORTHBROOK, Ill., Nov. 12, 2026 – The Allstate Corporation (NYSE: ALL) announced today its board of directors approved a quarterly dividend of $1.08 on each outstanding share of the corporation’s common stock to be payable in cash on Jan. 4, 2027, to stockholders of record at the close of business on Nov. 30, 2026.


Financial information, including material announcements about The Allstate Corporation, is routinely posted on[www.allstateinvestors.com](http://www.allstateinvestors.com/) .

About Allstate
The Allstate Corporation (NYSE:[ALL](https://www.allstate.com/) ) protects people from life’s uncertainties with affordable, simple and connected protection for[autos](https://www.allstate.com/auto-insurance) ,[homes](https://www.allstate.com/home-insurance) ,[renters](https://www.allstate.com/renters-insurance) ,[electronic devices](https://www.allstate.com/phone-protection-plus) and[identities](https://www.allstate.com/identity) . Products are available through a broad distribution network including Allstate agents, independent agents, major retailers, online and at the workplace. Allstate has 218 million policies in force and is widely known for the slogan “You’re in Good Hands with Allstate.” For more information, visit[www.allstate.com](https://www.allstate.com/) .
